newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 20.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Syrian vice-president says Turkey's operation in Iraq is an invasion.
- Palestinian telecommunications company plans to raise its capacity to 250,000 telephone lines in three years.
- Jordanian airline owes Jordanian oil refinery 134.2 million dinars.
- A Syrian trade team visits Iraq to revive trade relations between the two countries.
- Businessmen from the European Union and Gulf Arab states to discuss joint ventures at a meeting in Riyadh on Tuesday.
